settings.enabledHelp: Learners see and pay the price for their country, worked out from their location. Everyone else pays this plan's normal price.
settings.currenciesHelp: Each paid plan gets a price in these currencies, converted from its normal price at today's exchange rate and rounded to a clean amount. You can change any of them below.
settings.ratesNever: Exchange rates have not been fetched yet
settings.gatewayNote: Learners are only charged in a currency your payment gateway accepts. PhonePe and Cashfree take INR only, and eWay takes AUD and NZD. Razorpay needs international payments switched on in your Razorpay account.

plans.offNote: Regional pricing is off, so every learner pays the normal price. The prices below are kept for when you switch it on.
plans.empty: This payment option has no plans.
plans.noPrices: No regional prices yet. Choose currencies above, or add a country.

add.auto: Price it automatically from the exchange rate

delete.title: Remove the price for {{region}}?
delete.description: Learners there will get the price for their currency, or the normal price.

toast.refreshed: Prices updated from today's exchange rates
toast.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
